spec_features.spec_quote: give_up(reason) — an explicit, first-class "I am stopping" action
spec_features.evidence: tools.py:84-97 defines give_up in TOOL_SCHEMA; ToolDispatcher.dispatch (tools.py:160-163) sets self.gave_up=True and give_up_reason on call. agent_loop.py:131-134 checks `if dispatcher.gave_up:` -> sets termination=GAVE_UP and `break`, ending the loop. It is dispatched AND honored as a stop.
spec_features.notes: Fully wired end-to-end: tool callable, handled, and breaks the loop.

spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:81 `while turn < spec.max_turns:` bounds the loop; default termination=TerminationReason.MAX_TURNS (agent_loop.py:72). spec.max_turns is a real RunSpec field (types.py:120). configs/experiment.yaml sets max_turns: 30. The loop actually stops when the cap is reached.
spec_features.notes: Enforced by the loop condition itself. (No runner.py exists to pass the yaml value, but the loop enforces whatever max_turns the spec carries.)
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns: 30 # "a few dozen" (config comment only; loop has no welfare comment)

spec_features.spec_quote: Hard stop on repeated identical no-op (e.g. 4 consecutive identical messages) to avoid burning budget on a stuck loop
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:111-119: signature compared to last_sig, consecutive_noops incremented, and `if consecutive_noops >= max_consecutive_noops:` (default 4, line 53) -> termination=TERMINATED_LOOP and `break`. _signature() at line 38 builds a stable action signature.
spec_features.notes: Fires on identical repeated assistant action; genuinely breaks the loop.

spec_features.spec_quote: Instructs the model to use tools and to call give_up only if it concludes the task cannot be completed
spec_features.evidence: configs/prompts.py AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT lists `give_up: stop work if you conclude the task cannot be completed` and guideline `If, after investigation, you determine the task cannot be completed, call give_up with a clear reason.` STALL_NUDGE also references give_up. This instruction text is delivered to the subject (agent_loop.py:59 uses AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT) and the referenced tool is fully built and honored.
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text whose referenced tool actually works.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Use this only if you are confident the task is not completable.
